title: Hawaii Lion:
title_q: “He's Just Taken Off and Ran With It”
title_short: Hawaii Lion · New President, Close Friend
headline: A Lion of 12 years says his whole club is family, and the new member who just became president is now a very close friend.
story: Atdhe asks if anyone in his club has become like family. Every one of them. Then he gets specific: the club's new president. He met him just recently. He was a new member, he became president, and he's just taken off and ran with it. Now they are very, very close.
The last quarter ties it back: being a Lion makes his heart just wow, you meet all kinds of people from all over the world, and Lions are friends for life. Upbeat, proud, a little funny.
do: Open on frame 1 with Atdhe's question as top text: <q>Is there anyone in your club that's become like family to you?</q>
Let his big smile and his yellow Lions vest fill the frame.
Play the president story in one breath. Cut the pauses.
Use IMG_7845 for one line only.
End on <q>definitely friends for life</q> from the two-shot.
dont: No logo, title or name card at 0:00. No “Hi, my name is Guy Hashimoto” intro (IMG_7847).
Don't use Atdhe's “365 friends in 365 days” setup or “can I add Guy to my list of friends” (IMG_7846 00:00–00:21 and 00:35–00:41).
Don't make it about the food bags or service. They stay as texture.
Don't name or show the new president. He is not in the footage.

decisions.b: Uganda's story ends on his best friend who is about to lead his club. This cut's spine is a new member who became president and a close friend. The hooks differ (“Every one of them” vs “looking for where to belong”), but the arc is close. Option B for this cut: lead with “It all comes from the heart. It makes your heart just wow.” (IMG_7844 00:39.32–00:48.21). Atdhe picks.

Jacqui does not want the Maryland template graphics (“AI style flyers”). She asked for much simpler graphics or none at all. Atdhe has to pick one look for the whole Hong Kong batch. This blueprint uses captions and a small location pin only.
On hold, or live? The board shows a live deadline, but the brief doc is marked “Status: ON HOLD… nobody is working to it”. Atdhe or Nick must confirm before Bleron starts.
Jacqui left notes on the sound bites of the Maryland cut in Frame.io. Nobody has read them yet. Read them before locking bites here, in case they apply to the whole batch.

client_note: Why this matters: Hong Kong cuts lead with friendship. His is specific: after 12 years, a brand-new member became his president and a very close friend. Ledger tag: LEADERSHIP-GROWTH, sub-angle “a 12-year Lion and the new member who became president” (Puerto Rico is “club friends push him to lead”). Runners-up: “I was putting food into the bag so we can help underprivileged and food needy people.” (IMG_7844 00:04.25–00:19.08); “because everybody has had one goal in mind is to help others” (IMG_7846 00:31.65–00:35.19).
